person.name: Ishan Dubey
bio: I’m a Year 13 student at International Pioneers School in Thailand, exploring computer science, software engineering, and interactive systems.
I turn what I learn into useful software—from a news and research platform to tools for small businesses—and want to understand the engineering beneath it all.

projects.name: KRUNG
projects.summary: A Thailand-focused news and research platform that puts context ahead of headline volume. It brings storylines, concise summaries, and source material together so readers can follow the bigger picture.
projects.outcome: Learned to structure complex information, make sources visible, and design a clearer path from a headline to its context.

projects.name: OrderFlow
projects.summary: A commerce experiment for small businesses and online sellers. It connects products and storefront links with checkout, order organisation, and the practical details of fulfilment.
projects.outcome: Explored relational data, authentication, and mobile-first workflows across a complete product-to-order journey.

projects.name: Mitra
projects.descriptor: A little help on the desktop.
projects.summary: A Python desktop assistant exploring everyday tasks in one interface. Reminders, audio interaction, and quick app launching became a hands-on way to connect software behaviour with interface design.
projects.outcome: Practised Python application structure, desktop UI design, and bringing several small utilities into one coherent experience.

projects.name: Academic portfolio
projects.descriptor: A clear home for my work.
projects.summary: This static portfolio brings my academic journey and independent work into one accessible, responsive space. It is built for GitHub Pages with relative assets, anchor navigation, and a downloadable academic CV.
projects.outcome: Connected reusable React components, accessible interactions, and an automated static build and deployment workflow.
